properties.comment: If you are experiencing an outage please call 1-800-900-2832 and ask to speak with a dispatcher.  We need to confirm details or your outage prior to dispatching a crew.

Crews report there is a down power line that needs to be repaird. Due to recent heavy rains service vehicle access is difficult and only accessible by mule. The CTEC Crew onsite is working on makikng safe repairs and may require having to climb the poles. No estimated time of restoration is available.  Addtional updates will be provided as soon as possible.
